proof.priority: The root active-query check occurs before either missing or leaf return, preserving E-QUERY-CYCLE even for an absent root.
proof.missing: The original DFS encounters the root first and returns None when no root snapshot exists; no dependency can be traversed.
proof.leaf: An inactive root with an empty dependency list has no transitive inputs, so the original DFS returns that same stored Arc.
proof.nonleaf: The original DFS loop, all dependency fingerprint checks, missing-input returns, active-ancestor errors and cycle detection are unchanged.
proof.root_reuse: Database::read borrows self immutably; the stored root Arc cannot change during traversal, so cloning the retained root reference equals the previous final map lookup.

tests.added_behavior: Active missing and active leaf roots reject; an unrelated inactive leaf remains readable; abort restores the same snapshot identity.
